target_customer: Developers and companies building AI agents that need tool access and persistent compute
problem: Building agents that use many models and tools, and giving them isolated computers that keep state across sessions, requires stitching together infrastructure.
business_model: Usage-based developer platform with free and Pro ($20 per month) tiers
product_category: AI agent infrastructure (MCP gateway, SDK, persistent VMs)

founders.name: Cathy Di
founders.background_notes: Listed as Catherine Di on the company site.

technical_complexity.rationale: The current product spans virtualization, distributed storage, networking and scheduling (50ms boot, VM isolation per company site), which is hard for an 8 person team; the earlier MCP gateway and SDK was moderate.

defensibility.rationale: Agent sandbox and gateway markets were crowded and priced competitively; a lead would rest on engineering depth rather than lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sandbox and agent compute offerings from several vendors were compared side by side in 2025 and 2026 roundups; no acquisition of Dedalus found.

market_need_then: In 2025 the Model Context Protocol and agent tool use were spreading quickly, and developers needed hosted gateways and isolated compute for agents. Evidence of demand for Dedalus itself is the $11M seed and open source SDK adoption claims.

branding.name_origin: Named after Daedalus, the craftsman of Greek myth who survived by building with intention, according to the founding brand designer's portfolio page.

identity.visual_style: ASCII art inspired by bird murmuration, bird with coding symbols (designer portfolio)

branding.community_and_virality: Hosted a YC Agents hackathon event listing; no other community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Mythological name with a thoughtful identity but common spelling variants (Daedalus) and several unrelated Daedalus products dilute search; no press about the brand itself.

pivots.from: MCP gateway and SDK, 'Vercel for Agents' (Launch HN, 2025-08)
pivots.to: Persistent computers for AI agents (Dedalus Machines)
pivots.why: Not stated in sources found; the YC page now leads with persistent compute.

outcome_analysis: Dedalus Labs rode the 2025 surge in agents and MCP, launching on Hacker News in August 2025 and announcing an $11M seed in October 2025 co-led by Kindred and Saga, which is a fast raise for a two founder S25 company from Princeton with DeepMind and Voyage AI experience. Its focus later moved from a gateway to persistent machines, entering a crowded sandbox market, so the outcome is still open.
notes: Seed of $11M confirmed by the company blog and StartupHub; SignalBase reports $8.0M (treated as conflicting aggregator). Dealroom also lists YC, Liquid 2, E14 and Operator Partners as investors (unverified, not recorded). Competitor search returned mostly 2026 roundups (E2B, Modal, Daytona) not dated to the S25 batch, so the list is left empty rather than backdating them.
